text:
ConocoPhillips rose 2.1% today as oil prices held steady at elevated levels—US crude is trading at $96.24 per barrel while global Brent crude is at $125.44, a wide spread driven by geopolitical supply concerns. The stock has climbed 12% over the past two weeks as a backdrop of Middle East tensions (Saudi airport attack, Houthi strikes on shipping lanes) and Ukraine energy disruptions kept crude prices firm, offsetting some downward pressure from the Trump administration's push to increase Russian diesel supplies to cool fuel prices before the midterm elections.

The sharp gap between US and global oil prices reflects a key reality for a major oil producer: while supply disruption fears support crude values abroad, political pressure to flood markets with discounted Russian fuel creates cross-currents that keep long-term price direction uncertain heading into the election period.
